meta.name: detecting-aws-cloudtrail-anomalies
meta.description: Detect unusual API call patterns in AWS CloudTrail logs using boto3, statistical baselining, and behavioral analysis to identify credential compromise, privilege escalation, and unauthorized resource access.

copy.tagline: 检测 AWS CloudTrail 中的异常 API 调用模式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要识别 AWS 账户中的可疑活动或潜在安全威胁。
copy.tagline_en: Detect unusual API call patterns in AWS CloudTrail logs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to identify suspicious activities or potential security threats in your AWS account.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能分析 AWS CloudTrail 日志，检测异常 API 调用模式，如凭证泄露、权限提升和未授权资源访问，并生成 JSON 报告。
howto.when: 当需要调查 AWS 安全事件、构建检测规则或进行威胁狩猎时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析最近24小时的CloudTrail日志，找出异常API调用。
say.note: Claude 会查询日志并生成异常检测报告。

say.text: 检查是否有来自陌生地理区域的API调用。

howto.what_en: Claude can analyze AWS CloudTrail logs to detect unusual API call patterns such as credential compromise, privilege escalation, and unauthorized resource access, and produce a JSON report.
howto.when_en: Triggered when investigating AWS security incidents, building detection rules, or performing threat hunting.

say_en.text: Analyze CloudTrail logs for the last 24 hours and find anomalous API calls.
say_en.note: Claude will query logs and generate an anomaly report.

say_en.text: Check for API calls from unfamiliar geographic regions.
